title: Code Path Lens
user: Developers reviewing an unfamiliar code path who need a small, deterministic view of the relevant callers, callees, types, and data boundaries instead of navigating an entire repository.
smallest_useful_product: An LSP/tree-sitter CLI and static viewer that starts at a symbol, follows a bounded call/type/data path, and emits a source-linked graph with explicit unresolved edges. Non-goals: code generation, cloud indexing, or natural-language answers.
success_measure: In user tests, developers locate a relevant implementation path in an unfamiliar repository 30% faster than with editor search alone.
constraints: Respect .gitignore and generated-code exclusions; use language adapters with clear fallbacks; static approximation must never claim runtime completeness.
